QF.id: SIA Case Studies on SAS Standards_19

question.text: For the AB Responsible Services IWMP case, 177 hectares of land were brought under irrigation. Under SAS-200, this metric is BEST classified as an indicator of:

explanation.text: The Logic: Hectares irrigated is a physical activity deliverable — an OUTPUT. The OUTCOME would be yield change; the IMPACT would be farmer income change or food security. Classifying correctly matters for indicator mapping in the Social Impact Assessment Report. The Trap: Option A confuses input (capital, labour) with output. Options C and B are the downstream stages. Cross-Exam Context: Same input-output-outcome-impact ladder appears in XII (Securities Markets Foundation Ch 1) and X-A / X-B (Investment Adviser). Assessor's Pro-Tip: When drafting the Theory of Change, colour-code indicators by stage (input/output/outcome/impact). If more than half your indicators are outputs, the Report is weak on outcome evidence — flag it before end-line.
